response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_statuses FROM status_counts), status_analysis AS (SELECT sc.status, sc.record_count, CAST(sc.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share, 1.0 / t.num_statuses AS avg_share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT status, record_count, share, share - avg_share AS above_average FROM status_analysis WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;
